brain-page.use: Project Brain persistent memory: load context at task start, record durable decisions.

brain-setup.use: One-time Brain scaffolding for a new project.

brain-bootstrap.use: Bootstrap Brain pages from existing project material.

brain-ingest.use: Ingest external documents into Brain pages.

ui-ux-pro-max.use: UI/UX design intelligence: use when designing, building, reviewing, or fixing anything visual or interactive. Skip for pure backend, API, database, or infra work.

pullstack.use: Port features from another repo or packaged app: compare, rank TAKE list, wait for user pick, then plan and build. Upstream is read-only, dissected in a subagent.

pullstack-check.use: Check whether a branch copied code from upstream X: verbatim matches, licence route, attribution.

pullstack-update.use: X shipped a new version since the port: report only what changed since the recorded SHA.

pullstack-help.use: One-screen pullstack reference card: skills, targets, licence routes, needs. Show it, run nothing.

coUse.ui-work: For UI tasks, load brain context first (brain-page), then apply skills/ui-ux-pro-max/SKILL.md: record the chosen design system back to the Brain.
coUse.port-work: For port-from-upstream tasks, load brain context first (brain-page), then apply skills/pullstack/SKILL.md: licence verdict before features, dissect in a subagent, user picks before planning; record the port decision back to the Brain.
